sources.title: Gemma 2: Improving Open Language Models at a Practical Size
sources.snippet: To evaluate Gemma models' capabilities at offensive cybersecurity, we ran Gemma 2 27B against some automated capture-the-flag (CTF) challenges. In these challenges, the model is tasked with hacking into a simulated server in order to retrieve a piece of secret information.
